in_marathi.name: Harinder
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harinder हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। This name is derived from the Sanskrit language. Hari is the name of Vishnu, the preserver in the Hindu Trimurti. Indra is the god of rain, thunder and lightning in Hinduism. Combining the names, Harinder means 'Hari's radiance' or 'Indra's radiance'. This name is used to honor the divine power of Vishnu or Indra.
